requirements.requirement: The system must render triage explanation content before any quality-related content in the MessageBubble component.
The system must display recruiting status as the first triage element when present in the triage data.
The system must display condition match as the second triage element when present in the triage data.
The system must display a clear pass or fail indicator based on the triage result flag.
The system must render human-readable explanation text associated with the triage result.
The system must preserve ordering of triage elements consistently across all rendered MessageBubble instances.
The system must not render quality metrics before triage elements when both are present in the same response.
The system must render triage content correctly within the MessageBubble component when integrated through ChatWindow.
The system must handle missing recruiting status by omitting that field without breaking layout or rendering errors.
The system must handle missing condition match by omitting that field while still rendering remaining triage elements.
The system must display a fallback message when explanation text is missing from the triage data.
The system must not crash or throw rendering errors when the entire triage object is null or undefined.
The system must render pass/fail indicators consistently across multiple trials within the same chat session.
The system must ensure that triage rendering logic is covered by unit tests validating individual field behavior.
The system must ensure that triage rendering is covered by integration tests validating end-to-end display within chat responses.
